color_evidence.basis: Estimated visually from official product photographs; not published textile or official HEX values.

research_log.action: Inspected seed roles and independently searched this variant; official front photograph reviewed, artwork mapped onto the common source master.

observations: Black upper body fading into purple toward the hem; black sleeves, collar and cuffs, thin purple shoulder piping, dark curved side gussets. Metallic logos deliberately removed.
omitted: Club emblems, manufacturer logos, sponsors, badges, numbers and lettering. Textile micro-weave is not redrawn.

visual_review.notes: Compared saved official front photo and rendered 512 × 512 SVG. Major color bands/fade/pinstripes, sleeve panels, cuff colors and collar treatment are mapped to the mandatory original silhouette. Garment color HEX values and pattern coordinates are visual estimates; no claim of pixel-identical textile reproduction. Original 200 × 200 light map preserved.
visual_review.quality_review: Smooth contour and retained source folds inspected at 2048 × 2048; no source bitmap or source kit color/pattern changes.

revision_reason: Replace pixel-step paint boundary with the supplied smooth reference-front-2 Bezier outline; interpolate the original lighting transitions at 0.55 source units.
